LESSON: PREPARATION OF ANIMAL PRODUCTS • PROCESSING FISH • DRESSING POULTRY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.4: Preparation of Animal Products • Processing fish • Dressing poultry
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Preparation of Animal Products • Processing fish • Dressing poultry, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 8 AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to dress poultry carcass?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Preparation of Animal Products • Processing fish • Dressing poultry together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Integrity: The learner applies laid down procedures when dressing poultry.

● Respect: The learner appreciates diverse opinions as they discuss in groups how to dress poultry and process fish.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Health Promotion Issues: The learners promote food nutrition and security as they observe the laid down procedures of dressing poultry

and processing fish to maintain hygiene.

● Disaster risk reduction: The learner observes safety protocols when handling knives for the processing of fresh fish through scaling and

gutting.

Link to other subjects:

• Learners relate the parts removed in fish and poultry to knowledge of parts of fish and birds learnt in integrated science.

Suggested Learning Resources:

● Fresh fish

● Knife

● Signs Language Dictionary

● Salt
